editorial:
Imagine being a huge fan of the biggest boy band in the country and finding out they are playing a show far away from your hometown. That is exactly the mess Gabi, Manu, and Ritinha find themselves in. These three friends are totally obsessed with the Slavabody Disco Disco Boys and will stop at nothing to get to Rio de Janeiro. The vibe is light, colorful, and full of the kind of chaotic energy you get when you are a teenager with a huge dream and not much money. It feels like a giant party on screen, capturing that feeling of friendship and the wild things you do for the people you admire.

You will love the chemistry between the three girls because their friendship feels real and funny. The pacing is quick, so you never get bored, although some of the jokes are a bit silly. If you enjoy movies about music and teen adventures, you should definitely check this out.
endingExplained: After a series of crazy mishaps and hurdles, the three girls finally make it to Rio de Janeiro just in time for the concert. They get to see the Slavabody Disco Disco Boys live, which is the ultimate payoff for all their hard work. The movie wraps up by showing that their friendship grew stronger through the trip. They realize that while the pop stars are great, the memories they made together are the real prize.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves teen comedies and catchy pop music.
